Del Pilar; to Regulate the Investment of Said Funds, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The sum of fifteen thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for expenditure, together with an additional sum of fifteen thousand
pesos, of which sum five thousand pesos shall be appropriated by the provincial board and five thousand by
the municipality of Bulacan, and the remaining five thousand raised by voluntary subscription, for the
purchase of a lot and the construction thereon of a schoolhouse dedicated to the memory of Marcelo H. del
Pilar, in the barrio of San Nicolas, municipality of Bulacan, Province of Bulacan.

The building to be constructed with said funds shall bear, on its facade, the likeness of Marcelo
H. del Pilar, either in bust or in relief, and such inscriptions in bronze or marble as may be approved, in
conformity with existing regulations.

Any unexpended balance of the funds herein appropriated left after the completion of the
building may be expended for the purchase, care, and suitable arrangement of the land on which the building
shall be constructed.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 20, 1919.
